senses.definition: Pt. pass. כָּמֻס Dt 32:34 is not this stored up (laid up in store) with me (‖ חָתוּם בְּאוֹצְרֹתָ֑י); but read prob. כָּנֻם in same meaning (v. כנס, and Dr Dt 32:34).
